opening.argument: The presentation solicits at least $100 of Bitcoin for entry into a trading pool and claims that the balance will compound daily as the percentage is applied to the new balance. It also ties financial rewards to a two-sided recruitment structure: participants must introduce one person on each side, maintain at least $200 in their own position, and wait to qualify for a claimed weekly bonus based on the smallest leg. Those requirements make recruitment and continued personal funding central to the offered income streams. The available evidence does not establish that trading occurred, bonuses were paid, or participants experienced a loss.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
it will be compounding daily, meaning that the percentage you earn will be from the new balance at the end of the day and not your original balance.
This means you have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business.
You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position.
This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.
